effect.purpose: Effect v4 core pinned to the stable release this repo runs (effect@4.0.0, the lockfile's resolution); the authority for v4 APIs including effect/cli. Re-pin whenever the lockfile's effect moves to a new 4.x.

effected.purpose: The @effected kit source at the kit release this repo installs (@effected/pnpm-plugin-effect@0.13.0) — authority for app, store, config-file, toml, xdg, github, schemastore, cli, env and their transitive deps. Re-pin with the catalog plugin.
